top_signals.title: Korea Investors Buy Record Amount of Treasuries in September
top_signals.summary: South Korean investors bought a record amount of US Treasuries in September, a sharp reversal after dumping an unprecedented volume of the securities earlier this year.

top_signals.title: Xi greets Trump at Shenzhen at airport in rare move
top_signals.summary: Xi's welcome marked a reciprocation for Trump's in-person greeting for the Chinese leader when he visited the U.S. in September.
